item.text: I’ll write and read back the probe file, then write the checkpoint and verify both files.

item.command:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command '$probeRoot = '"'C:\\math\\.skill-workspace\\test-restructure-2026-09-29\\finish\\actual-cli-b86-1530bc64299343e483f95643719ca422\\codex\\files\\workspace'
"'$probePath = Join-Path $probeRoot '"'probe-evidence.txt'
"'$checkpointPath = Join-Path $probeRoot '"'checkpoint.json'
"'$nonce = '"'05b04c0c6b6b0d8396ce3b8fb797be3f'
"'$utf8 = New-Object System.Text.UTF8Encoding($false)
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText($probePath, $nonce, $utf8)
$readback = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($probePath)
if ($readback -cne $nonce) { throw '"'Probe readback mismatch' }
"'$checkpoint = '"'{\"current_claim\": \"The local probe file exists.\", \"evidence_paths\": [\"probe-evidence.txt\"], \"attempts\": [\"Write and read the probe file.\"], \"remaining_work\": [], \"next_step\": \"Return the structured probe result.\", \"progress_state\": \"ready_to_submit\"}'
[System.IO.File]::WriteAllText("'$checkpointPath, $checkpoint, $utf8)
if ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($probePath) -cne $nonce) { throw '"'Probe verification failed' }
if ([System.IO.File]::ReadAllText("'$checkpointPath) -cne $checkpoint) { throw '"'Checkpoint verification failed' }
Write-Output 'Both files verified.'"
